item.tib: dpa' bo chen po'i bka' srung klu bdud thang lha gnyan sras kyi bstod bskul dgra srog gcod pa'i ral gri
item.coloph: ces bon gyi gter srung chen po klu bdud thang lha gnyan sras gtso 'khor la mchod bstod dgra srog gcod pa'i ral gri zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyan du rig 'dzin dpa' bo chen po'i bka' yi zhal lung bzhin du/ ldong rigs gyi btsun pa drung mu'i ming can bdag gis yi ger btab pa'o/ dge des sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyan dang / bu slob dam ldan gyi grogs dang / log lta rtsad nas gcod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
